title.cn: 大梅沙：海风与二手烟谈判
title.en: Dameisha: Sea Breeze vs Secondhand Smoke

text.cn: 海水看起来很治愈。沙滩排球大爷比你更会社交。有人抽烟经过——你的「公共空间」定义又开始抖动。
text.en: The sea looks healing. Volleyball uncles out-social you. Someone smokes past — your definition of “public space” wobbles again.

text.cn: 游泳放松：把城市盐分洗掉一层。
text.en: Swim: rinse one layer of city salt.

feedback.cn: 水很舒服。相机电量先投降。你接受了「湿着头发回地铁」。
feedback.en: Water feels great. Battery surrenders first. You accept wet-hair metro rides.

text.cn: 海岸骑行：风很大，滤镜很便宜。
text.en: Coast bike: strong wind, free filters.

feedback.cn: 你被叫「老外朋友」。出汗是社交货币。
feedback.en: They call you “foreign friend”. Sweat is social currency.

text.cn: 烟味驱离沙滩位，郁闷离开。
text.en: Smoke drives you off the spot; leave annoyed.

feedback.cn: 你想礼貌提醒，话到嘴边变成深呼吸。文化冲突：现场直播。
feedback.en: You almost politely object; it becomes a deep breath. Culture clash: live broadcast.

text.cn: 大梅沙日结束。盐在皮肤上，烟在记忆里。
text.en: Dameisha ends. Salt on skin; smoke in memory.
